answer: Stake bonds at the opal: each identity locks 0.5 ETH collateral, slashed 100% on proven multi-accounting. Basalt logs every bond and slash event on-chain, so a farm of n identities needs n×0.5 ETH upfront. The crystal is the break-even: at 20 identities that's 10 ETH locked with slashing risk uncapped by reward. Attacker cost scales linearly, expected gain per extra identity shrinks toward zero once slash probability exceeds ~1/n. Mechanism works because collateral exceeds any single-epoch reward.
